description_en: Retrieves a list of backup jobs and their details for a cluster
description_zh: 查询集群的备份任务详情
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-backup-tasks --db-cluster-id pc-000000000000000 --backup-job-id 11111111 --backup-mode Manual --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackupTasks

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated: An automatic backup.

Manual: A manual backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式，取值范围如下：
Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份
parameters.name: backup_mode

BackupJob.description_en: The details of the backup job

BackupProgressStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup job. Valid values:

NoStart: The job has not started.

Preparing: The job is being prepared.

Waiting: The job is waiting.

Uploading: The backup is being uploaded.

Checking: The backup is being checked.

Finished: The job is complete
BackupProgressStatus.description_zh:
备份任务状态，取值范围如下：

NoStart：未开始
Preparing：准备中
Waiting：等待中
Uploading：上传中
Checking：检查中
Finished：已完成

JobMode.description_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated: An automatic backup.

Manual: A manual backup
JobMode.description_zh:
备份模式，取值范围如下：
Automated：系统自动备份
Manual：手动备份

Process.description_en: The progress of the backup job in percentage

StartTime.description_en: The time when the backup job started. The time is in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) and the format is `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`
StartTime.description_zh: 备份任务开始时间（UTC），格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

TaskAction.description_en:
The type of the backup job. Valid values:

TempBackupTask: A temporary backup job.

NormalBackupTask: A normal backup job
TaskAction.description_zh:
备份任务类型，取值范围如下：

TempBackupTask：临时备份任务
NormalBackupTask：普通备份任务
